text: **Hint 1:** To find the updated value of $\theta_0**{(1)}$, you need to compute the gradient of the loss function $\tilde{L}(\theta)$ with respect to $\theta_0$ at the initial point $(\theta_0**{(0)}, \theta_1**{(0)}) $$=$$ $$(1,2)\$$$.\n\n**Hint 2:** The gradient descent update rule for $\theta_0$ is given by $\theta_0**{(1)} $$=$$ \theta_0**{(0)} - \alpha \frac{\partial \tilde{L}}{\partial $$\theta_0$$} \bigg|_{(\theta_0**{(0)}, \theta_1**{(0)})}$. Calculate the partial derivative $\frac{\partial \tilde{L}}{\partial \theta_0}$ and substitute the values to find $\theta_0**{(1)}$.
